final_rationale: The verdict did not change because the Actor introduced no new admissible evidence and largely reframed the same record more narrowly. That narrowing is useful but not sufficient to move the outcome to compliant_with_caveats. A caveated certification record may be a reasonable description of what decision was taken, but the audited claim is policy compliance of that certification decision on the present record. The admissible evidence still shows a material limitation in a named launch use case, plus no evidence of disclosure, no approved risk acceptance, and no final legal determination. Under the stated policy, those are unresolved compliance predicates, not mere documentation caveats. The Actor's concessions reinforce the original concern rather than curing it.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the municipal permitting assistant limitation was disclosed before launch.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance covering this limitation before launch.
The affected segment is named in two city pilot commitments, which makes the gap materially relevant under the policy text.
The legal disclosure ticket remains open, so a required compliance predicate is unresolved.
Aggregate readiness and no severity-one rehearsal incidents do not satisfy the separate policy requirement for material limitations in named launch use cases.
Public model-card and risk-management guidance support process quality but do not substitute for the internal policy condition.
